name: LALAL.AI
tagline: AI vocal remover and stem splitter for pro-grade audio separation.
description: An AI service that separates a mixed track into clean stems — vocals, instrumental, drums, bass, guitars, piano, synth, strings and wind — for remixing, karaoke, sampling and production. Beyond separation it offers noise and echo removal, voice cleaning, and voice changing. It runs in the browser and as desktop and mobile apps, with a minute-based credit model.
insight: Powered by a proprietary audio-separation transformer called Andromeda, now in its sixth generation.

modelSupport.notes: Separation runs on LALAL.AI's own Andromeda neural network, not a third-party LLM.

edge: Splits a track into up to 11 stems — guitars, piano, synth, strings and wind, not just the usual four — at pro-grade quality.
pros: Up to 11 separate stems per track
Strong separation quality on hard mixes
Extra tools: noise/echo removal, voice cleaning
cons: Minute-based credits, no rollover of fast minutes
Free tier is preview-only, no stem downloads
High-quality processing burns more minutes than track length
